title: feat(frb): move FRB codegen into whitenoise-rs
body:
![marmot](https://blossom.primal.net/0d80f60e49ed191332de5c793af8dcd359ddbaafadfb1502bee89aff427dff4d.jpg)

## What changes

Replaces the force-pushed `flutter-package` orphan branch with a Dart pub registry served from this repo's `gh-pages` branch. The Flutter app consumes it via a standard `hosted:` pubspec source.

Master now owns the full Flutter package template at `crates/whitenoise-frb/template/`. The wrapper crate and Dart package rename from `rust_lib_whitenoise` to `whitenoise_frb`, dropping the FRB-default `rust_lib_*` prefix.

## How publishing works

Each codeowner push to master triggers `.github/workflows/frb-codegen.yml`:

1. Stage the package shell from the vendored template
2. Run `flutter_rust_bridge_codegen` to produce fresh Dart bindings
3. Vendor the wrapper crate, rewriting the `whitenoise` path-dep to a git rev pinning the source SHA
4. Build a tarball plus a Pub Spec v2 version JSON
5. Apply the version to a gh-pages worktree (index update + tarball drop)
6. Commit and push gh-pages

The codeowner gate is unchanged, and concurrency serializes publishes so gh-pages stays consistent across overlapping runs.

## Versioning

Each publish gets `0.0.0-dev+<short-sha>`. Flutter pins specific versions. Per semver, build metadata after `+` does not participate in version ordering, so `version: any` would resolve arbitrarily; pin-only.

## Consuming from the Flutter app

```yaml
dependencies:
  whitenoise_frb:
    hosted: https://marmot-protocol.github.io/whitenoise-rs
    version: "0.0.0-dev+<short-sha>"
```

The latest published SHA lives at `/api/packages/whitenoise_frb` in the registry.

## Migration sequence

1. Bootstrap gh-pages and enable Pages serving (done)
2. Land this PR; first master push publishes a version
3. Land the Flutter cutover PR on `marmot-protocol/whitenoise`
4. Delete the orphan branch: `git push origin --delete flutter-package`

Full details, including the Flutter-side checklist, live in `docs/frb-flutter-migration.md`.

## Verified

- `just frb-stage && just frb-generate && just frb-check` runs end-to-end
- `just frb-publish-local` produces a spec-valid tarball
- Pages serves the bootstrap landing page at https://marmot-protocol.github.io/whitenoise-rs/

The known coverage flake (`test_interrupted_migration_restores_valid_encrypted_temp_when_database_missing`) is pre-existing; fails on both this branch and its prior commit.

---

A marmot once kept its outbound mail in a side burrow that everyone had to know the name of. Now it runs a proper post office with numbered packages on the shelf. The side burrow gets filled in once the last package ships.

title: Add audio metadata to chat media records and imeta helpers
body:
## Summary
- Extend `FileMetadata` with optional `duration_ms` and `waveform` fields so audio display metadata is stored with media records.
- Parse optional `duration` and `waveform` fields from incoming `imeta` tags without dropping malformed media references.
- Add a public helper for building chat-media `imeta` tags and thread audio metadata through upload and integration-test flows.
- Update the chat media integration scenario to verify audio attachments preserve duration and waveform metadata end to end.

- `just int-test chat-media-upload` passed locally with Docker services.

title: Recover some coverage on account DB wrappers and membership ops
body:
## Summary

The arch-refactor merge dropped CI coverage 94.95% → 89.02%. This PR adds 8 targeted unit tests covering paths the refactor introduced without tests — three new per-account-DB repositories and the lightweight column-flip behavior of `MembershipOpsForGroup::archive` / `unarchive`.

## What's tested

`database/account/push_registrations.rs` (2 tests)
- `upsert_binds_repo_account_pubkey_to_returned_registration` — the wrapper's only added behavior is binding `account_pubkey`; this locks it in.
- `separate_accounts_have_independent_per_account_dbs` — the per-account-DB architectural invariant (post-#786 split); two repos over distinct account DBs must not see each other's rows. Inner `PushRegistration` tests share one pool and can't express this.

`database/account/group_push_tokens.rs` (1 test)
- `upsert_binds_repo_account_pubkey_to_returned_token` — pubkey-binding contract on the wrapper.

`database/account/published_key_packages.rs` (1 test)
- `mark_key_material_deleted_by_id_flips_one_row_only` — contrapositive regression guard for PR #822: the by-id variant must NOT cascade to dual-kind twins. A future refactor that "fixes consistency" by accidentally hash_ref-scoping the by-id variant trips this test. No inner-test analogue.

`accounts_groups.rs` (4 tests)
- `test_archive_sets_archived_at`, `test_archive_is_idempotent`, `test_unarchive_clears_archived_at`, `test_unarchive_on_unarchived_chat_is_no_op` — lightweight column-flip tests for `MembershipOpsForGroup::archive`/`unarchive` via the `get_or_create(None)` path. Distinct from the existing `chat_list.rs` archive tests, which spin up a real MLS group via `create_group(...)` and assert stream emit; these target the wrapper's mutation contract without the MLS setup cost.

## What's deliberately not in this PR

- **Wrapper pure-delegation roundtrip tests.** Pure pass-through `Ok(Inner::fn(...).await?)` calls add coverage but no signal — the inner SQL has its own tests. Per the user rule "tests that really increase coverage, not tests that are not testing anything," these were dropped after review.
- **Hash_ref-scoped twin tests** for `mark_consumed` / `mark_key_material_deleted_by_hash_ref`. Already covered by the inner tests `test_mark_consumed_updates_timestamp_for_twins` and `test_mark_key_material_deleted_by_hash_ref_marks_twins` in `database/published_key_packages.rs`.
- **Archive/unarchive emit-frame tests.** Already covered at the heavyweight level by `test_archive_chat_emits_to_both_stream_channels` in `chat_list.rs`.
- **Schema-shadowing fix.** The account-DB tests currently hand-roll a `DROP TABLE + CREATE TABLE` because `AccountDatabase::new` uses `open_without_migrations` (running the full timeline here would require wiring a shared pool). Filed for a separate follow-up — a `setup_account_db_with_migrations()` helper that the whole `account/*.rs` suite can migrate to.

## Coverage math caveat

Coverage probably lands around 90–92% local lib — clears the post-merge CI baseline of 89.02% but doesn't recover the full pre-merge 94.95%. The remaining gap is structural: arch-refactor genuinely deleted code paths that had coverage, and shallow tests aren't the right fix.

## Verification

- `just check-fmt` ✓
- `just check-clippy` ✓
- `cargo test --lib whitenoise::database::account` — 55 pass
- `cargo test --lib whitenoise::accounts_groups::tests` — all pass including the 4 new archive/unarchive
